component.name: LirtUp Forge
component.summary: Upscale any X11 window in real time
Escala cualquier ventana X11 en tiempo real

description.p: LirtUp Forge upscales any X11 or XWayland window to full screen in real time, with CuNNy neural networks running on Vulkan compute. Mouse clicks and motion are forwarded to the original window.

ul.li: 9 SRCNN models, from the fastest to the sharpest, and 4x with two passes
Scaling modes: model, sampling, Magpie effects and finishing touches, shared by profiles
The 117 effects of Magpie, run unmodified
Frame generation with lsfg-vk, through its layer or built in
A toolbar over the game, a stats panel, a tray icon and a daemon that scales matching windows

description.p: Version 2.0 is a rewrite in Rust that replaces the Python 1.x and reads its configuration.
Rewrite in Rust with a new interface. It reads the 1.x configuration and offers to move it to scaling modes.
